title: Chapter 374: Leader Selection
content:
Chapter 374: Leader Selection

Wang Shuo himself was born as a bricklayer, so building the city wall was no pressure.

So, he found a suitable place and started to "make things smooth" and make bricks for the city wall.

Now it has become quite dangerous to go out to clear the earth mother worms. You may encounter the opponent's generals at any time. It is better to stay at home and improve the defense.

At this time, Wang Shuo was surprised to find that these summoned generals basically have life skills, and 5 of them are also bricklayers, which saves Wang Shuo a lot of trouble.

The only part of the city wall that really needs to be repaired is the one at the gourd mouth, and not many bricks are needed.

One day is enough.

So, Wang Shuo organized everyone to make kilns and carve talismans.

The next day, Wang Shuo had just repaired the city wall, and the competition to select the commander began.

Yesterday, Wang Shuo had summoned all the generals and war generals that could be summoned.

Wang Shuo currently has 10 senior generals, 20 intermediate generals, 30 junior generals, and 3 generals.

The lineup is luxurious.

[The leader selection competition officially begins. ]

After hearing this prompt, Wang Shuo and his troops were all teleported to a battlefield.

[Each person gets a resurrection coin, which cannot be transferred and will be collected after the competition. ]

After hearing this prompt, Wang Shuo had a bottom line in his heart. After all, this is equivalent to an internal selection competition. If there are really large-scale casualties, it will be very bad to fight against the enemy later.

[This competition is a two-on-one fight. ]

A team of friendly troops soon appeared in front of Wang Shuo, but at this time, the friendly troops can also be called enemy troops.

"Is the opposite Wang Shuo's brother?"

Wang Shuo looked carefully, what a coincidence, isn't this Huang Qiang?

After seeing Wang Shuo's military appearance, Huang Qiang decisively sold Wang Shuo a face and chose to surrender.

You should know that in this competition, once the resurrection coin is used, you can no longer fight.

In other words, the most critical point of this competition is to do your best to save your own generals.

After all, most people already have 3 generals, and everyone has similar top combat power.

The key to victory, in addition to your own combat power, is the number of generals.

The combat power of the summoned generals is the same, there is no difference, only the strength of the main general is different.

"Brother, I remember it, thank you for your help."

Huang Qiang admitted defeat, Wang Shuo did not lose a general, and his advantage will be greater in the next battle.

After withdrawing from the battle, Wang Shuo was equivalent to returning to the audience.

At this time, he could see the duel between other generals.

After watching for a while, Wang Shuo lost interest.

These two people are obviously chickens pecking each other.

Both of them have only one extra general, and the generals are only 20 junior generals.

With Wang Shuo's strength, he can completely crush them.

After a few minutes, the two decided the winner, and the winner was a general who was good at using bows and arrows.

Wang Shuo saw at this time that generals also had military attributes, and not everyone liked to be a cavalry general.

There were also many shield soldiers, spear soldiers, and archers.

Wang Shuo even saw a strange general who used his fists to fight the enemy directly, and was obviously a boxer.

Wang Shuo thought at this time, isn't Zhao Bangde a boxer?

Then he put away his contempt.

Every profession, when upgraded to the later stage, should be extremely powerful.
